stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 已正確完成「造口併發症與護理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「迴腸／結腸造口技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: 'complications and nursing care' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Ileostomy/colostomy technique' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Quality, error and safety review'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
準備清單完成。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Preparation checklist complete.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出發炎性腸道疾病手術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Surgery for inflammatory bowel disease.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依發炎性腸道疾病手術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Surgery for inflammatory bowel disease.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
已正確完成「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 發炎性腸道疾病手術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Surgery for inflammatory bowel disease.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」在發炎性腸道疾病手術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' within Surgery for inflammatory bowel disease, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis'.
steps.failure: 若「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」是發炎性腸道疾病手術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' is a core component of Surgery for inflammatory bowel disease; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis'?
options: 已正確完成「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「克隆氏狹窄成形術與潰瘍性結腸炎的 IPAA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Strictureplasty for Crohn's and IPAA for ulcerative colitis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。

steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

stages.title: 第一節 · 機制與病理生理（免費試學）

steps.objectiveEn: Grasp the background and basic mechanism of Diverticulitis and Hartmann's procedure.
steps.instruction: 閱讀並整理：Hinchey 分級、腹腔鏡沖洗與初級吻合。

steps.observation: 以流程圖畫出因果鏈。
steps.observationEn: Draw the causal chain as a flow diagram.
steps.failure: 把相關性誤認為因果是最常見的推理錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: Hinchey 分級、腹腔鏡沖洗與初級吻合。
knowledge.textEn: Hinchey classification, laparoscopic lavage and primary anastomosis.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

steps.observationEn: Complete the glossary.

steps.check: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
steps.checkEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.

stages.title: 第二節 · 臨床表現與診斷

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：Hinchey 分級
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「Hinchey 分級」在憩室炎處置與 Hartmann中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Hinchey classification' within Diverticulitis and Hartmann's procedure, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「Hinchey 分級」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'Hinchey classification': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「Hinchey 分級」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'Hinchey classification'.

steps.failureEn: If 'Hinchey classification' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「Hinchey 分級」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Hinchey classification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「Hinchey 分級」是憩室炎處置與 Hartmann的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Hinchey classification' is a core component of Diverticulitis and Hartmann's procedure; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

steps.objective: 整合治療原則、證據等級與現代意義。

steps.instructionEn: Describe the scenario → list differentials → choose management → predict outcome → compare with reality.

steps.checkEn: Case reasoning complete.

knowledge.text: 每個病例都應回答：我學到什麼、下次會怎麼做。

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出肝臟切除的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Hepatic resection.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：Couinaud 分段、Pringle 手法、殘肝體積與 CUSA。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Couinaud segments, Pringle manoeuvre, future liver remnant and CUSA.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「Couinaud 分段」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Couinaud segments' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「殘肝體積與 CUSA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'future liver remnant and CUSA' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 已正確完成「殘肝體積與 CUSA」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「Couinaud 分段」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: 'future liver remnant and CUSA' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Couinaud segments' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依肝臟切除的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Hepatic resection.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 肝臟切除的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Hepatic resection.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：Couinaud 分段
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「Couinaud 分段」在肝臟切除中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Couinaud segments' within Hepatic resection, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「Couinaud 分段」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Couinaud segments': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「Couinaud 分段」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Couinaud segments'.
steps.failure: 若「Couinaud 分段」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Couinaud segments' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「Couinaud 分段」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Couinaud segments' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「Couinaud 分段」是肝臟切除的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Couinaud segments' is a core component of Hepatic resection; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：Couinaud 分段」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Couinaud segments'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「Couinaud 分段」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Couinaud segments' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Pringle manoeuvre' within Hepatic resection, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「Pringle 手法」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。

steps.failure: 若「Pringle 手法」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。

steps.check: 已正確完成「Pringle 手法」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Pringle manoeuvre' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：Pringle 手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: Pringle manoeuvre'?
options: 已正確完成「Pringle 手法」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'Pringle manoeuvre' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 3：殘肝體積與 CUSA」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出肝臟切除的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Hepatic resection and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「Pringle 手法」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Pringle manoeuvre' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出胰十二指腸切除的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Pancreaticoduodenectomy.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：可切除性評估、胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Resectability, pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依胰十二指腸切除的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Pancreaticoduodenectomy.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「可切除性評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Resectability' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 胰十二指腸切除的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Pancreaticoduodenectomy.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：可切除性評估
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「可切除性評估」在胰十二指腸切除中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Resectability' within Pancreaticoduodenectomy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「可切除性評估」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Resectability': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「可切除性評估」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Resectability'.
steps.failure: 若「可切除性評估」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Resectability' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「可切除性評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Resectability' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「可切除性評估」是胰十二指腸切除的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Resectability' is a core component of Pancreaticoduodenectomy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：可切除性評估」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Resectability'?
options: 已正確完成「可切除性評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
已正確完成「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: 'Resectability' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」在胰十二指腸切除中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' within Pancreaticoduodenectomy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula'.
steps.failure: 若「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」是胰十二指腸切除的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' is a core component of Pancreaticoduodenectomy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「可切除性評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Resectability' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出胰十二指腸切除的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Pancreaticoduodenectomy and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 已正確完成「胰腸吻合與術後胰瘻」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: 'pancreaticojejunostomy and post-operative pancreatic fistula' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「可切除性評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Resectability' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出遠端胰臟切除的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Distal pancreatectomy.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：脾臟保留與釘合殘端。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Spleen preservation and stapled stump.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依遠端胰臟切除的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Distal pancreatectomy.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 遠端胰臟切除的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Distal pancreatectomy.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：脾臟保留與釘合殘端
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Spleen preservation and stapled stump
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」在遠端胰臟切除中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' within Distal pancreatectomy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump'.
steps.failure: 若「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」是遠端胰臟切除的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' is a core component of Distal pancreatectomy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：脾臟保留與釘合殘端」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Spleen preservation and stapled stump'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 已正確完成「脾臟保留與釘合殘端」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'Spleen preservation and stapled stump' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出遠端胰臟切除的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Distal pancreatectomy and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
